reviewStandard: strict modern real-time hero-character head review
improvements: AgX preserves facial highlight rolloff that was clipped by the earlier Standard review transform.
Reduced subsurface blur keeps the nose, cheek and eyelid plane changes more readable.
Two-scale procedural normals provide a stronger owned skin-detail baseline without adding external textures.
blockingFindings: Skin detail is still too subtle at full-head distance and lacks convincing region-specific pore direction.
The eyelid apertures, canthus closure and exposed sclera remain synthetic.
Lip vermilion volume and the inner-mouth transition still read as a flat dark cut.
Hairline and long-hair mass remain below the required standard; r1091 sheet-like families are unchanged.
Eyebrows remain too pale and sparse to frame the face.
nextRequiredPass: Improve eyelid aperture and canthus closure under the new AgX review baseline, then return to a card-and-fiber hybrid hair architecture.
